model: Matching-free projection model inspired by the manuscript's Section IV hypotheses (not that section; on hold after the review of 29.10.2026): redundant hypergraph H0 of the neuron, local counters f(e) over its originals, attractor = {f >= 0.8}, novelty map with consolidation (only neurons with >= 2 originals compete), professor's point 3 as an iterated pairwise competition, parametric layer, centre-line shape anchors as synapses

training.originals: first 10 images per letter of the bank (official train), no selection: 260 originals + augmentations (rotation +-10 deg, shift +-3 px)

detector: four skeleton channels (thresholds 110 / 150 / 190 with the production rules, fine 150), MAX over channels

selection.final: combination: R1 β 0.3 + R4 θ 0.7 + R2 shape anchors

protocol: all choices on dev (2 600 other bank images, official train), official test run once on the frozen configuration
dataset: EMNIST-letters (26 classes, case merged), official test 20 800 images (tests/emnist_testfull)
